thread_text:
nina-peopleops: Heads-up  I prototyped a one-paragraph self-review prompt bundle for ICs who keep saying "I don't know what to write" during cycle. Short, copy-pasteable. Thoughts?
jo-engineer: Love it. Make sure there's a sentence for impact + one for learning.
maria-hrbp: Add a quick "how to evidence" line: paste one link or two bullets with dates. Helps calibrators.
tom-manager: Also include an optional two-line manager note template so managers can respond quickly in-thread.
nina-peopleops: OK will paste a short version below. Keep it under 6 lines so folks can actually finish it.

---
`Self-Review Tiny Bundle (copyable)`

- One-line summary of impact: [e.g., "Led infra change that reduced inference costs by 12% and improved p95 by 30ms"]
- Key outcome / metric: [metric / target / baseline] (1 line)
- Evidence (paste 1 link or 2 bullets with dates): [date  short fact / PR / ticket]
- What I learned / growth area (1 line): [e.g., "Need to improve rollout testing and stakeholder comms"]
- What I'd do differently (1 line): [e.g., "Automate smoke checks and add canary steps"]

`Manager quick reply (copyable)`
- Positive: "Thanks  this is clear and helpful. I value X and Y here."
- Coaching: "Noted  can we pair on adding automated smoke checks next sprint?"

`How to use`
- Paste it into your self-review form or send to your manager before your 1:1. Keep it short so you actually finish it.
---

maria-hrbp: This is great. Recommend adding a note: "Add 2 small examples for calibration" but it's optional.

jo-engineer: Will use this. Thanks!
